purpose: Check Gemian's cached charger-voltage report without initiating a new ADC conversion.

source_audit.finding: The power-supply ChargerVoltage getter returns the cached BAT_ChargerVoltage field; the battery update copies it from BMT_status.charger_vol, which is populated by the battery-meter charger-voltage getter. Reading this sysfs property does not itself request a conversion. The alternative battery_common_fg_20.c has the same cached-property behavior.

classification: Gemian reports no charger voltage or online power in this boot. This cached software report is not an independent port-voltage measurement or a confirmed charger-response test.
